source.description: AI-authored Kotlin/Wasm harness compiled against the human-authored kotlinx.serialization-json 1.11.0 library (kotlinx.serialization, Apache-2.0), aggregating 10 scenario groups and 40 deterministic corpus calls into one library-level Wasm module.

toolchain.name: Kotlin/Wasm + Binaryen
toolchain.version: Kotlin Gradle plugin 2.3.21; kotlinx.serialization-json 1.11.0; wasm-opt version 125

description: Kotlinx Serialization JSON fixture aggregating 10 scenario groups and 40 deterministic calls against kotlinx.serialization-json.
notes: Aggregates the previous JSON-focused Kotlinx fixtures into one library-level module so the Kotlin/Wasm runtime and kotlinx.serialization JSON implementation are embedded once while preserving all scenario coverage.
